tree_family.thresholds: midpoints between distinct training feature values
tree_family.growth: greedy best-first split with maximum leaves equal to two raised to maximum_depth
tree_family.split_acceptance: risk-adjusted training objective must improve by more than 1e-12
tree_family.leaf_arm_score: board-group-balanced mean normalized raw reduction minus risk multiplier times its sample standard error

cross_validation.candidate_family: Cartesian product of three frozen feature tiers, two maximum depths, and three risk multipliers
cross_validation.selection_objective: maximum aggregate held-out payoff-normalized raw reduction; fixed b3r2 wins tolerance ties, then lower feature tier, depth, risk multiplier, and candidate_id
cross_validation.final_fit: fit the selected candidate specification once on all discovery groups and serialize the resulting tree

runtime_charging.fixed_b3r2: charge cold_exact_leaf_online_seconds for b3r2 and no feature cost
runtime_charging.adaptive: conservatively charge the complete recorded boundary_feature_seconds for every target, measured tree evaluation, and cold_exact_leaf_online_seconds only for the selected non-no-op arm
runtime_charging.state_work: no_op has zero solver state visits; searched arms use their recorded actual_state_visits
runtime_charging.exact_candidate_evaluation: label-only; report a separately charged exact-recertification diagnostic but never use it in the causal rule

post_screen.failure: retain fixed b3r2, stop adaptive width on this workload, and do not generate a replication
post_screen.pass: commit the selected specification and serialized tree before freezing or generating a fresh development replication
